claim.claim-text: 1. A developing device (10, 110) comprising:
2. The developing device according to Claim 1, comprising:

a first gear (31) for rotating the developing roller (12); a second gear (32) that is in mesh with the first gear (31) and is rotatable in the first direction about the second axis (A2); and a clutch (40) positioned between the coupling (22) and the second gear (32) in the axial direction and that rotates together with the coupling (22), the clutch (40) being configured to come into engagement with a portion of the second gear (32) and cause the second gear (32) to rotate in the first direction together with the coupling gear (22B) when the coupling (22) rotates in the first direction, the clutch (40) being configured to neither come into engagement with the portion of the second gear (32) nor cause the second gear (32) to rotate together with the coupling (22) when the coupling rotates in the second direction, wherein when the coupling gear (22B) rotates in the first direction, the moving gear (33) moves to the first position and goes out of mesh with the first gear (31), and the first direction rotation of the coupling gear (22B) causes the second gear (32) to rotate in the first direction together with the coupling gear (22B) with an aid of the clutch (40) and to cause the first gear (31), being in mesh with the second gear (32), to rotate in the second direction; and wherein when the coupling gear (22B) rotates in the second direction, the moving gear (33) moves to the second position and comes into mesh with the first gear (31), and the second direction rotation of the coupling gear (22B) causes the moving gear (33) being in mesh with the coupling gear (22B) to rotate in the first direction and to cause the first gear (31), being in mesh with the moving gear (33), to rotate in the second direction;
optionally wherein:

the moving gear (33) includes a large-diameter gear (33B) and a small-diameter gear (33A) that rotate together, the large-diameter gear (33B) being in mesh with the first gear (31), the small-diameter gear (33A) being in mesh with the coupling gear (22B); and the second gear (32) has a larger diameter than the coupling gear (22B).

3. The developing device according to Claim 2, wherein when the coupling gear (22B) rotates in the second direction, the clutch (40) goes out of engagement with the portion (FS1) of the second gear (32) and the second direction rotation of the first gear (31) causes the second gear (32), being in mesh with the first gear (31), to rotate in the first direction.
4. The developing device according to any one of Claims 1 to 3, further comprising:

5. The developing device according to Claim 2 to 4, wherein the clutch (40) is movable in the axial direction between an engaged position where the clutch (40) is in engagement with the portion (FS1) of the second gear (32) and a disengaged position where the clutch (40) is out of engagement with the portion (FS1) of the second gear (32).
6. The developing device according to Claim 5, wherein the second gear (32) has

a rotation transmitting surface (FS1) that comes into contact with the clutch (40) when the clutch (40) rotates in the first direction; and an inclined surface (FS2) that moves the clutch (40) toward the disengaged position when the clutch (40) rotates in the second direction, the inclined surface (FS2) being inclined with respect to a direction of rotation of the clutch (40).

7. The developing device according to Claim 6, wherein the second gear (32) includes a first projection (P1), the first projection (P1) having the rotation transmitting surface (FS1) and the inclined surface (FS2); optionally wherein:

the second gear (32) includes a plurality of first projections (P1) each being the first projection (P1), and the plurality of first projections (P1) are arranged side by side in a direction of rotation of the coupling (22).

8. The developing device according to Claim 6 or 7, wherein the clutch (40) has a first clutch surface (FC 1) to be in contact with the rotation transmitting surface (FS1), and a second clutch surface (FS2) to be in contact with the inclined surface (FS2).

9. The developing device according to Claim 8, wherein the clutch (40) includes a second projection (P2), the second projection (P2) having the first clutch surface (FC1) and the second clutch surface (FC2); optionally wherein:

the clutch (40) includes a plurality of second projections (P2) each being the second projection (P2), and the plurality of second projections (P2) are arranged side by side in a direction of rotation of the coupling (22).

10. The developing device according to any one of Claims 5 to 9, wherein the coupling (22) has a first coupling surface (FP1) that moves the clutch (40) toward the disengaged position when the clutch (40) rotates in the second direction; optionally wherein the clutch (40) has a third clutch surface (FC3) to be in contact with the first coupling surface (FP1).
11. The developing device according to any one of Claims 2 to 10, further comprising:

a first idle gear (34) that is in mesh with the first gear (31); a second idle gear (35) that is in mesh with the first idle gear (34); and a developing roller gear (23) positioned at an end portion of the developing roller (12) and that rotates together with the developing roller (12), the developing roller gear (23) being in mesh with the second idle gear (35) the developing device optionally further comprising:

the supply roller (13) includes a supply roller shaft (13A) extending in the axial direction, and wherein the supply roller gear (24) is attached to an end portion of the supply roller shaft (13A) and is rotatable together with the supply roller shaft (13A).
12. The developing device according to Claim 11,

wherein the developing roller (12) includes a developing roller shaft (12A) extending in the axial direction, and wherein the developing roller gear (23) is attached to an end portion of the developing roller shaft (12A) and is rotatable together with the developing roller shaft (12A).

13. The developing device according to any one of Claims 1 to 12, wherein the developing device is a developing cartridge (10) and/or wherein the developing device is attachable to and detachable from a drum cartridge (5) including a photosensitive drum.

14. The developing device according to Claim 13, wherein the toner accommodation chamber (11B) that is separate from the developing chamber (11A) is attachable to and detachable from the developing device.

15. The developing device according to any one of Claims 1 to 14, wherein the coupling (22) is rotatable about the second axis when receiving a driving force, the coupling (22) being rotatable both in the second direction and the first direction; optionally wherein the coupling (22) includes a recessed portion (22A) for receiving the driving force, the recessed portion (22A) being recessed in the axial direction.
